source.text: Ὀφείλομεν δὲ ἡμεῖς οἱ δυνατοὶ τὰ ἀσθενήματα τῶν ἀδυνάτων βαστάζειν, καὶ μὴ ἑαυτοῖς ἀρέσκειν.

records.literal_gloss: Ought and we the strong the weaknesses of the not-strong to bear, and not ourselves to please.

en.L: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of those without strength, and not to please ourselves.
en.B: Those of us who are strong have a duty to carry the weaknesses of those who lack strength, instead of living to please ourselves.
en.R: Some of us have a strong faith. We should help carry the burdens of those whose faith is weak, and not just do what pleases us.

es.L: Ahora bien, nosotros, los fuertes, debemos cargar con las debilidades de los que no tienen fuerza, y no agradarnos a nosotros mismos.
es.B: Los que somos fuertes tenemos el deber de cargar con las debilidades de quienes no tienen fuerza, en lugar de vivir para agradarnos a nosotros mismos.
es.R: Algunos de nosotros tenemos una fe fuerte. Debemos ayudar a llevar las cargas de los que tienen una fe débil, y no hacer solo lo que nos gusta.

sw.L: Basi sisi wenye nguvu tuna deni la kubeba madhaifu ya wale wasio na nguvu, na si kujipendeza wenyewe.
sw.B: Sisi wenye nguvu tuna wajibu wa kuchukua madhaifu ya wale wasio na nguvu, badala ya kuishi ili kujipendeza wenyewe.
sw.R: Baadhi yetu tuna imani yenye nguvu. Tunapaswa kuwasaidia wale wenye imani dhaifu kubeba mizigo yao, wala tusifanye tu yale yanayotupendeza sisi.

fr.L: Or nous, les forts, nous devons porter les faiblesses de ceux qui ne sont pas forts, et ne pas nous plaire à nous-mêmes.
fr.B: Nous qui sommes forts, nous avons le devoir de porter les faiblesses de ceux qui manquent de force, au lieu de vivre pour notre propre plaisir.
fr.R: Certains d’entre nous ont une foi forte. Nous devons aider ceux dont la foi est faible à porter leurs fardeaux, et ne pas faire seulement ce qui nous plaît.

ko.L: 우리 강한 사람들은 강하지 못한 사람들의 약점을 짊어져야 하고, 자기를 기쁘게 하지 말아야 합니다.
ko.B: 우리 가운데 믿음이 강한 사람들은 힘이 없는 사람들의 약점을 함께 짊어져야 합니다. 자기만 기쁘게 하며 살아서는 안 됩니다.
ko.R: 우리 가운데는 믿음이 강한 사람들이 있습니다. 우리는 믿음이 약한 사람들의 짐을 함께 져 주어야 합니다. 자기가 좋아하는 것만 해서는 안 됩니다.

vi.L: Còn chúng ta, những người mạnh, có bổn phận mang lấy những sự yếu đuối của những người không mạnh, và không làm vừa lòng chính mình.
vi.B: Chúng ta là những người mạnh có bổn phận gánh vác sự yếu đuối của những người thiếu sức mạnh, thay vì sống để làm vừa lòng chính mình.
vi.R: Một số người trong chúng ta có đức tin mạnh. Chúng ta nên giúp mang gánh nặng của những người có đức tin yếu, chứ không chỉ làm những gì mình thích.

pt.L: Ora, nós, os fortes, devemos carregar as fraquezas dos que não são fortes, e não agradar a nós mesmos.
pt.B: Nós, que somos fortes, temos o dever de carregar as fraquezas dos que não têm força, em vez de vivermos para agradar a nós mesmos.
pt.R: Alguns de nós têm uma fé forte. Devemos ajudar a carregar os fardos dos que têm a fé fraca, e não fazer apenas o que nos agrada.

am.L: እኛ ብርቱዎች የሆንን ኃይል የሌላቸውን ሰዎች ድካም ልንሸከም ይገባናል፤ ራሳችንን ደስ ልናሰኝም አይገባም።
am.B: ከእኛ መካከል ብርቱዎች የሆንን ራሳችንን ደስ ለማሰኘት ከመኖር ይልቅ ኃይል የሌላቸውን ሰዎች ድካም የመሸከም ግዴታ አለብን።
am.R: ከእኛ አንዳንዶቻችን ጠንካራ እምነት አለን። እምነታቸው ደካማ የሆኑትን ሰዎች ሸክማቸውን በመሸከም ልንረዳቸው ይገባል፤ ደስ የሚያሰኘንን ብቻ ማድረግ የለብንም።

decisions.choice: the strong and the weak: strong and weak in faith, as in chapter 14
alternatives: strong and weak in body or social standing
decisions.reason: The chapter goes on from 14:1, "the one who is weak in faith": believers whose conscience will not let them eat some foods or ignore some special days. Paul counts himself among the strong ("we"), since he is sure no food is unclean in itself (14:14). ἀδύνατος means "without strength", the opposite of δυνατός.

decisions.choice: bear: carry and support, not just put up with
decisions.reason: βαστάζω is to carry a load, as in Galatians 6:2, "carry one another's burdens". The strong are not only to tolerate the scruples of the weak but to take them on themselves, as Christ did (verse 3).

decisions.choice: ought: an obligation, a debt owed
decisions.reason: ὀφείλω is to owe, the same word as in 13:8, "owe no one anything except to love one another". Bearing with the weak is a debt of love, not an optional kindness.

decisions.choice: a strong faith ... whose faith is weak
decisions.reason: Readable says what kind of strength is meant, from 14:1, so that a young reader does not think of bodily strength.

decisions.choice: tuna deni la (L); tuna wajibu wa (B)
decisions.reason: The verb is the language of debt, as the meaning decision says. Literal keeps the picture with "tuna deni la" (we have a debt to); Balanced says "tuna wajibu wa" (we have a duty to), which keeps the sense of obligation without the money image.

decisions.choice: the letter's 합쇼체 with "여러분" and "우리" continues through chapters 15-16; "강한 사람" and "약한 사람" as in chapter 14
decisions.reason: As settled at 1:1. The strong and the weak are strong and weak in faith, as in chapter 14 (meaning decision); Balanced and Readable say "믿음이" so Korean readers do not think of bodily strength.

decisions.choice: "짊어지다" (L); "함께 짊어지다" (B); "짐을 함께 져 주다" (R)
decisions.reason: Bear means carry and support, not just put up with (meaning decision); "참아 주다" would say only the second.

decisions.choice: "mang lấy" (L); "gánh vác" (B); "giúp mang gánh nặng" (R)
decisions.reason: To bear is to carry and support, not just to put up with (m2). "Chịu đựng" would say only that the strong tolerate the weak; "mang" and "gánh vác" say they carry the load.

decisions.choice: "có bổn phận" (L, B); "nên" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is to owe, an obligation like a debt (m3). "Bổn phận" is a duty one owes; Readable says "nên", as the English Readable says "should".

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The English capitalises pronouns for God and Christ as a reader setting, here mostly in the psalm quotations. The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change in Amharic, and the pronouns in this chapter are written once, with no span.

source.text: ἕκαστος ἡμῶν τῷ πλησίον ἀρεσκέτω εἰς τὸ ἀγαθὸν πρὸς οἰκοδομήν·

records.literal_gloss: Each of us the neighbor let please for the good toward building up;

en.L: Let each of us please [his] neighbor for the good, for building up;
en.B: Each of us should please our neighbor, aiming at what is good for them and what builds them up.
en.R: Each of us should try to please the people around us, doing what is good for them and what helps them grow.

es.L: Que cada uno de nosotros agrade al prójimo para el bien, para edificación;
es.B: Cada uno de nosotros debe agradar a su prójimo, buscando lo que le hace bien y lo que lo edifica.
es.R: Cada uno de nosotros debe tratar de agradar a los que tiene cerca, haciendo lo que les hace bien y lo que les ayuda a crecer.

sw.L: Kila mmoja wetu ampendeze jirani kwa ajili ya [lililo] jema, kwa ajili ya kujenga;
sw.B: Kila mmoja wetu ampendeze jirani yake, akilenga yaliyo mema kwake na yale yanayomjenga.
sw.R: Kila mmoja wetu ajitahidi kuwapendeza watu walio karibu naye, akiwatendea mema na kuwasaidia kukua.

fr.L: Que chacun de nous plaise au prochain, pour le bien, en vue de l’édification ;
fr.B: Chacun de nous doit plaire à son prochain, en visant ce qui est bon pour lui et ce qui l’édifie.
fr.R: Chacun de nous doit chercher à faire plaisir aux gens qui l’entourent, en faisant ce qui est bon pour eux et ce qui les aide à grandir.

ko.L: 우리 각 사람은 선을 위하여, 세워 주기 위하여 이웃을 기쁘게 해야 합니다.
ko.B: 우리는 각자 이웃을 기쁘게 하되, 그에게 유익하고 그를 세워 주는 일을 해야 합니다.
ko.R: 우리는 저마다 주변 사람들을 기쁘게 하려고 애써야 합니다. 그들에게 좋은 일, 그들이 자라도록 돕는 일을 해야 합니다.

vi.L: Mỗi người chúng ta hãy làm vừa lòng người lân cận vì điều tốt, để gây dựng;
vi.B: Mỗi người chúng ta nên làm vừa lòng người lân cận, nhắm đến điều tốt cho họ và điều gây dựng họ.
vi.R: Mỗi người chúng ta nên cố gắng làm vui lòng những người chung quanh, làm điều tốt cho họ và giúp họ lớn mạnh.

pt.L: Cada um de nós agrade ao próximo para o bem, para a edificação;
pt.B: Cada um de nós deve agradar ao próximo, buscando o que é bom para ele e o que o edifica.
pt.R: Cada um de nós deve procurar agradar às pessoas que estão à nossa volta, fazendo o que é bom para elas e o que as ajuda a crescer.

am.L: እያንዳንዳችን ባልንጀራውን ለበጎ፣ ለማነጽ ደስ ያሰኝ፤
am.B: እያንዳንዳችን ለእርሱ የሚጠቅመውንና የሚያንጸውን ነገር በማሰብ ባልንጀራችንን ደስ እናሰኝ።
am.R: እያንዳንዳችን በዙሪያችን ያሉትን ሰዎች ለማስደሰት እንሞክር፤ የሚጠቅማቸውንና እንዲያድጉ የሚረዳቸውን እናድርግ።

decisions.choice: neighbor: the fellow believer next to us
decisions.reason: πλησίον is "the one near", the neighbor of Leviticus 19:18 (quoted in 13:9). Here, after verse 1, it is above all the weaker believer in the same church, though the command reaches further.

decisions.choice: for the good, for building up: the aim and limit of pleasing others
decisions.reason: The two phrases say why and how far to please a neighbor: for their real good and to strengthen them. This is not pleasing people to win their favor, which Paul rejects (Galatians 1:10).

decisions.choice: building up: strengthening someone's faith and life together
decisions.reason: οἰκοδομή is the building of a house, used for helping one another grow in faith and for strengthening the church, as in 14:19.

decisions.choice: the people around us
decisions.reason: "Neighbor" can suggest only the person next door; Readable says "the people around us".

decisions.choice: l’édification, édifier (L, B), as in 14:19
decisions.reason: The building word of 14:19-20 comes back here (meaning decision); Literal and Balanced keep "édifier", and Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: "세워 주다" (L, B); "자라도록 돕다" (R), as at 14:19
decisions.reason: Building up: strengthening someone's faith and life together (meaning decision); the same words as 14:19 keep the link.

decisions.choice: "người lân cận" (L, B); "những người chung quanh" (R); "gây dựng" as in 14:19
decisions.reason: The neighbor is the fellow believer next to us (m1). "Người lân cận" is the word for the neighbor of the commandment; "hàng xóm" is only the person living next door.

decisions.choice: o próximo
decisions.reason: The English Balanced keeps "neighbor". Portuguese "o próximo" is the word of the commandment (13:9) and means any fellow human being, never the person next door ("o vizinho"), so it needs no explanation at Balanced. Readable says "as pessoas que estão à nossa volta", as the English Readable does.

source.text: καὶ γὰρ ὁ Χριστὸς οὐχ ἑαυτῷ ἤρεσεν· ἀλλὰ καθὼς γέγραπται· Οἱ ὀνειδισμοὶ τῶν ὀνειδιζόντων σε ἐπέπεσαν ἐπ’ ἐμέ.

records.literal_gloss: Even for the Christ not himself pleased; but just as it has been written: The insults of the insulting you fell on me.

en.L: For even the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} did not please {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}; but just as it is written: "The insults of those insulting {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} fell on {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
en.B: For even {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} did not please {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}. Instead, as it is written, "The insults of those who insult {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have fallen on {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
en.R: Even {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} did not live to please {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}. As Scripture says, "When people insulted {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, the insults fell on {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."

es.L: Porque ni aun {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} se agradó a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}}; sino, como está escrito: «Los insultos de los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} insultan cayeron sobre {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}».
es.B: Porque ni siquiera {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} vivió para agradarse a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}}. Al contrario, como está escrito: «Los insultos de los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} insultan han caído sobre {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}».
es.R: Ni siquiera {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} vivió para agradarse a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}}. Como dice la Escritura: «Cuando la gente {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} insultaba, los insultos caían sobre {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}».

sw.L: Kwa maana hata {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} hakujipendeza {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}; bali kama ilivyoandikwa: "Matukano ya wale wanaokutukana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} yaliniangukia {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}."
sw.B: Kwa maana hata {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} hakuishi kwa ajili ya kujipendeza {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}. Badala yake, kama ilivyoandikwa, "Matukano ya wale wanaokutukana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} yameniangukia {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}."
sw.R: Hata {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} hakuishi ili kujipendeza {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}. Kama Maandiko yasemavyo, "Watu walipokutukana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, matukano hayo yaliniangukia {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}."

fr.L: Car même le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} ne s’est pas plu à {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} ; mais, comme il est écrit : « Les insultes de ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}insultent sont tombées sur {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. »
fr.B: Car même le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} n’a pas cherché à se plaire à {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}. Au contraire, comme il est écrit : « Les insultes de ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}insultent sont retombées sur {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. »
fr.R: Même le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} n’a pas vécu pour se faire plaisir à {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}. Comme le dit l’Écriture : « Quand des gens {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}insultaient, c’est sur {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} que les insultes tombaient. »

ko.L: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서도 자기를 기쁘게 하지 않으셨기 때문입니다. 오히려 기록된 것과 같습니다. "주님을 비방하는 사람들의 비방이 저에게 떨어졌습니다."
ko.B: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서도 자기를 기쁘게 하지 않으셨습니다. 오히려 성경에 기록된 대로입니다. "주님을 모욕하는 사람들의 모욕이 저에게 쏟아졌습니다."
ko.R: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서도 자기를 기쁘게 하려고 살지 않으셨습니다. 성경에 이렇게 기록되어 있습니다. "사람들이 주님을 모욕할 때, 그 모욕이 저에게 쏟아졌습니다."

vi.L: Vì ngay cả {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} cũng đã không làm vừa lòng chính mình; nhưng như có chép: "Những lời sỉ nhục của những kẻ sỉ nhục {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đổ trên tôi."
vi.B: Vì ngay cả {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} cũng đã không làm vừa lòng chính mình. Trái lại, như có lời chép: "Những lời sỉ nhục của những kẻ sỉ nhục {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đổ xuống trên tôi."
vi.R: Ngay cả {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} cũng không sống để làm vừa lòng chính mình. Như Kinh Thánh chép: "Khi người ta sỉ nhục {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, những lời sỉ nhục ấy đã đổ trên tôi."

pt.L: Pois também {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} não agradou a {{deity_pronoun:si mesmo|Si mesmo}}; mas, como está escrito: "Os insultos dos que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} insultam caíram sobre {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}."
pt.B: Pois nem mesmo {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} agradou a {{deity_pronoun:si mesmo|Si mesmo}}. Ao contrário, como está escrito: "Os insultos dos que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} insultam caíram sobre {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}."
pt.R: Nem mesmo {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} viveu para agradar a {{deity_pronoun:si mesmo|Si mesmo}}. Como dizem as Escrituras: "Quando as pessoas {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} insultavam, os insultos caíam sobre {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}."

am.L: {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሑ}} እንኳ ራሱን ደስ አላሰኘምና፤ ነገር ግን እንዲህ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ [ሆነ]፦ «የሰዳቢዎችህ ስድብ በእኔ ላይ ወደቀ።»
am.B: {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሑ}} እንኳ ራሱን ደስ አላሰኘም። ይልቁንም እንዲህ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ ሆነ፦ «አንተን የሚሰድቡህ ሰዎች ስድብ በእኔ ላይ ወድቋል።»
am.R: {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሑ}} እንኳ ራሱን ለማስደሰት አልኖረም። መጽሐፍ እንዲህ ይላል፦ «ሰዎች አንተን ሲሰድቡ ስድባቸው በእኔ ላይ ወደቀ።»

decisions.choice: a quotation of Psalm 69:10
decisions.reason: Psalm 69 is the prayer of a righteous sufferer: "zeal for your house has consumed me, and the insults of those who insult you have fallen on me." Paul quotes the Greek translation, which matches the Hebrew here. The New Testament often reads this psalm as speaking of Jesus (John 2:17, 15:25, 19:28-29).

decisions.choice: you: God; me: Christ, speaking the psalm
decisions.reason: In the psalm the speaker addresses God. Paul hears Christ speaking it: the hostility people had toward God fell on Christ, and he took it rather than pleasing himself.

decisions.choice: but [it happened] as it is written
decisions.reason: The Greek leaves out a verb after "but": Christ did not please himself, but things went with him as Scripture had said. The sense is clear without it.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} ... {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}
decisions.reason: In the psalm God is addressed and Christ speaks, as the meaning decision says. Spanish puts the pronoun for God before the verb ("te insultan"), a separate word, so it takes the deity_pronoun span like "lo" and "le"; "mí" after "sobre" takes it too.

decisions.choice: free pronouns "wewe", "mimi", "mwenyewe" carry the span
alternatives: a span for every pronoun the English marks
decisions.reason: As in Romans 1, Swahili marks pronouns inside the verb ("wanaokutukana", "yaliniangukia"), where no capital is possible. The free pronouns "wewe" and "mimi" are added for emphasis, which suits the psalm, and they carry the deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}insultent; {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}
decisions.reason: In the psalm Christ speaks to God (meaning decision), so both pronouns take the span, as in English; French elides "te" before the verb, and the span holds the elided form.

decisions.choice: the psalm as words spoken to God in 합쇼체, with "주님" for God and the humble "저" for the speaker, Christ
decisions.reason: The "you" is God and the "me" is Christ speaking the psalm (meaning decision). Words to God are in 합쇼체 in this letter (10:16, 11:3), as Jesus prays to the Father in 합쇼체 in the Gospels.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in Korean; "자기" with the honorific verb, "주님" and "저"
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change (docs/korean-style.md section 7), as through the letter.

decisions.choice: "chính mình" for "himself", with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Vietnamese says "himself" with the reflexive "mình", which is not a personal pronoun and is not capitalised, so it takes no span, as in 10:20.

decisions.choice: "Ngài" for God and "tôi" for the speaker of the psalm, who is Christ (also 15:9)
alternatives: "Con" for Christ speaking to the Father
decisions.reason: In the psalm the speaker addresses God (m2). The form settled for a psalm speaker in 8:36 and 11:3 is "tôi" with "Ngài" for God. "Tôi" has no capitalised form, so the English deity span on "me" has no counterpart; the sentence before names Christ, so the reader knows who speaks.

decisions.choice: te (tu), for God in the psalm
decisions.reason: The psalm speaks to God (m2), so Portuguese uses "tu" at every level, as for all address to God (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 4); the same holds for the psalm quoted in verse 9.

source.text: ὅσα γὰρ προεγράφη, εἰς τὴν ἡμετέραν διδασκαλίαν ἐγράφη, ἵνα διὰ τῆς ὑπομονῆς καὶ διὰ τῆς παρακλήσεως τῶν γραφῶν τὴν ἐλπίδα ἔχωμεν.

records.literal_gloss: Whatever for was written beforehand, for our instruction was written, so that through the endurance and through the encouragement of the Scriptures the hope we may have.

en.L: For whatever was written beforehand was written for our instruction, so that through endurance and through the encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.
en.B: Everything that was written in earlier times was written to teach us. It was written so that we might have hope, as we endure and as the Scriptures encourage us.
en.R: Everything that was written in Scripture long ago was written to teach us. As we keep going and as the Scriptures encourage us, we can have hope.

es.L: Porque todo lo que se escribió de antemano, se escribió para nuestra enseñanza, a fin de que por medio de la perseverancia y por medio del aliento de las Escrituras tengamos esperanza.
es.B: Todo lo que se escribió en tiempos pasados se escribió para enseñarnos. Se escribió para que tengamos esperanza, mientras perseveramos y las Escrituras nos dan aliento.
es.R: Todo lo que se escribió en la Escritura hace mucho tiempo se escribió para enseñarnos. Mientras seguimos adelante y las Escrituras nos animan, podemos tener esperanza.

sw.L: Kwa maana kila kilichoandikwa zamani kiliandikwa kwa ajili ya mafundisho yetu, ili kupitia uvumilivu na kupitia faraja ya Maandiko tuwe na tumaini.
sw.B: Yote yaliyoandikwa nyakati za zamani yaliandikwa ili kutufundisha. Yaliandikwa ili tuwe na tumaini, tunapovumilia na Maandiko yanapotutia moyo.
sw.R: Kila kitu kilichoandikwa katika Maandiko zamani kiliandikwa ili kutufundisha. Tunapoendelea kuvumilia na Maandiko yanapotutia moyo, tunaweza kuwa na tumaini.

fr.L: Car tout ce qui a été écrit d’avance a été écrit pour notre instruction, afin que, par la persévérance et par l’encouragement des Écritures, nous ayons l’espérance.
fr.B: Tout ce qui a été écrit autrefois l’a été pour nous instruire. Cela a été écrit pour que nous ayons l’espérance, tandis que nous persévérons et que les Écritures nous encouragent.
fr.R: Tout ce qui a été écrit dans l’Écriture il y a longtemps a été écrit pour nous enseigner. Pendant que nous tenons bon et que les Écritures nous encouragent, nous pouvons avoir de l’espérance.

ko.L: 무엇이든지 전에 기록된 것은 우리의 교훈을 위하여 기록되었습니다. 이는 우리가 인내로, 그리고 성경의 위로로 소망을 가지게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 전에 기록된 것은 모두 우리를 가르치려고 기록되었습니다. 그래서 우리는 인내하며 성경이 주는 격려를 받아 소망을 가질 수 있습니다.
ko.R: 오래전에 성경에 기록된 모든 것은 우리를 가르치려고 기록되었습니다. 우리가 포기하지 않고 끝까지 견디며 성경에서 힘을 얻을 때, 우리는 소망을 가질 수 있습니다.

vi.L: Vì mọi điều đã được chép từ trước đều được chép để dạy dỗ chúng ta, để nhờ sự kiên trì và nhờ sự khích lệ của Kinh Thánh, chúng ta có niềm hy vọng.
vi.B: Mọi điều đã được chép từ xưa đều được chép để dạy dỗ chúng ta, hầu cho chúng ta có niềm hy vọng khi kiên trì chịu đựng và khi được Kinh Thánh khích lệ.
vi.R: Mọi điều được chép trong Kinh Thánh từ xưa đều được chép để dạy chúng ta. Khi chúng ta tiếp tục bền bỉ và được Kinh Thánh khích lệ, chúng ta có thể có niềm hy vọng.

pt.L: Pois tudo o que foi escrito antes foi escrito para o nosso ensino, para que, por meio da perseverança e por meio do encorajamento das Escrituras, tenhamos a esperança.
pt.B: Tudo o que foi escrito no passado foi escrito para nos ensinar. Foi escrito para que tenhamos esperança, à medida que perseveramos e as Escrituras nos encorajam.
pt.R: Tudo o que foi escrito nas Escrituras há muito tempo foi escrito para nos ensinar. Enquanto continuamos firmes e as Escrituras nos animam, podemos ter esperança.

am.L: ቀድሞ የተጻፈው ሁሉ ለእኛ ትምህርት ተጽፏልና፤ ይኸውም በጽናትና በመጻሕፍት ማበረታቻ በኩል ተስፋ እንዲኖረን ነው።
am.B: ቀድሞ የተጻፈው ሁሉ የተጻፈው እኛን ለማስተማር ነው። የተጻፈውም ስንጸና መጻሕፍትም ሲያበረታቱን ተስፋ እንዲኖረን ነው።
am.R: ከብዙ ዘመን በፊት በመጽሐፍ የተጻፈው ሁሉ የተጻፈው እኛን ለማስተማር ነው። ሳንታክት ስንቀጥልና መጻሕፍት ሲያበረታቱን ተስፋ ሊኖረን ይችላል።

decisions.choice: whatever was written beforehand: the Old Testament Scriptures
decisions.reason: Paul explains why a psalm written long before (verse 3) speaks to the church: the Scriptures of Israel were written with later believers in view, as he says also in 4:23-24 and 1 Corinthians 10:11.

decisions.choice: endurance (ours) and encouragement (from the Scriptures)
alternatives: endurance and encouragement both given by the Scriptures
decisions.reason: Each noun has its own "through". "Of the Scriptures" stands after encouragement, so the Scriptures at least give encouragement; they may also be the source of endurance. Verse 5 names God as the giver of both.

decisions.choice: the hope: the believer's hope of God's coming glory
decisions.reason: The article points to the hope Paul has already described: hope of sharing God's glory (5:2-5), waited for with endurance (8:24-25).

decisions.choice: we might have hope, as we endure and as the Scriptures encourage us
alternatives: through endurance and the encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn the two nouns into verbs, which keeps the two "through" phrases distinct in English.

decisions.choice: perseverancia; aliento / animar
decisions.reason: The first word is endurance that keeps going under pressure; "perseverancia" says that more clearly in modern Spanish than "paciencia". The second is encouragement rather than only comfort, so "aliento" (B, L) and "nos animan" (R). The same pair returns in verse 5.

decisions.choice: uvumilivu / kuvumilia; faraja / kutia moyo
decisions.reason: "Uvumilivu" (endurance, holding on) is the everyday word and is used for this term in the chapter; "saburi" leans towards patient waiting. "Faraja" at Literal, "kutia moyo" (to encourage) at Balanced and Readable, since the Scriptures here give courage as well as comfort.

decisions.choice: "인내" (L, B); "포기하지 않고 끝까지 견디다" (R), as at 8:25; "위로" (L); "격려" (B); "힘을 얻다" (R)
decisions.reason: Endurance is ours and encouragement comes from the Scriptures (meaning decision); "소망" as through the letter.

decisions.choice: "sự kiên trì" (L), "kiên trì chịu đựng" (B), "bền bỉ" (R) (also 15:5)
decisions.reason: Endurance is holding out under pressure (m2), the word kept as "kiên trì" since 5:3; "nhịn nhục" is kept for God's patience (2:4).

source.text: ὁ δὲ θεὸς τῆς ὑπομονῆς καὶ τῆς παρακλήσεως δῴη ὑμῖν τὸ αὐτὸ φρονεῖν ἐν ἀλλήλοις κατὰ Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν, ἵνα ὁμοθυμαδὸν ἐν ἑνὶ στόματι δοξάζητε τὸν θεὸν καὶ πατέρα τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: The and God of the endurance and of the encouragement may he give you the same to think among one another according to Christ Jesus, \v 6 so that with one mind in one mouth you may glorify the God and Father of the Lord of us Jesus Christ.

en.L: Now may the God of endurance and of encouragement give you to think the same [way] among one another according to {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus, \v 6 so that with one mind [and] with one mouth you may glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}.
en.B: May God, who gives endurance and encouragement, grant you to live in harmony with one another, as {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus would have you, \v 6 so that together, with one voice, you may give glory to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.
en.R: God gives us strength to keep going, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} encourages us. May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} help you agree with one another as you follow {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus. \v 6 Then all of you together, with one voice, will glorify God, the Father of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.

es.L: Y que el Dios de la perseverancia y del aliento {{plural_you:les|os}} conceda pensar lo mismo unos con otros según {{christos:Cristo Jesús|el Mesías Jesús}}, \v 6 para que de un mismo ánimo [y] con una sola boca {{plural_you:glorifiquen|glorifiquéis}} al Dios y Padre de nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}.
es.B: Que Dios, que da perseverancia y aliento, {{plural_you:les|os}} conceda vivir en armonía unos con otros, como {{christos:Cristo Jesús|el Mesías Jesús}} quiere, \v 6 para que juntos, con una sola voz, {{plural_you:den|deis}} gloria al Dios y Padre de nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}.
es.R: Dios nos da fuerzas para seguir adelante y nos anima. Que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:los|os}} ayude a estar de acuerdo unos con otros mientras {{plural_you:siguen|seguís}} {{christos:a Cristo Jesús|al Mesías Jesús}}. \v 6 Así todos {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} juntos, con una sola voz, {{plural_you:glorificarán|glorificaréis}} a Dios, el Padre de nuestro Señor {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}.

sw.L: Basi Mungu wa uvumilivu na wa faraja awape kuwa na fikira moja miongoni mwenu kwa kadiri ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu, \v 6 ili kwa nia moja [na] kwa mdomo mmoja mumtukuze Mungu na Baba wa Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.B: Mungu, ambaye hutoa uvumilivu na faraja, awawezeshe kuishi kwa umoja kati yenu, kama {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu apendavyo, \v 6 ili kwa pamoja, kwa sauti moja, mumpe utukufu Mungu na Baba wa Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.R: Mungu hutupa nguvu ya kuendelea, na hututia moyo. Awasaidie mpatane kati yenu mnapomfuata {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu. \v 6 Ndipo ninyi nyote pamoja, kwa sauti moja, mtamtukuza Mungu, Baba wa Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.

fr.L: Que le Dieu de la persévérance et de l’encouragement vous donne d’avoir les mêmes pensées les uns envers les autres selon le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus, \v 6 afin que, d’un même cœur [et] d’une seule bouche, vous glorifiiez le Dieu et Père de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.B: Que Dieu, qui donne la persévérance et l’encouragement, vous accorde de vivre en harmonie les uns avec les autres, comme le veut le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus, \v 6 afin que, tous ensemble et d’une seule voix, vous rendiez gloire au Dieu et Père de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}.
fr.R: Dieu nous donne la force de tenir bon, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous encourage. Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous aide à être d’accord les uns avec les autres, en suivant le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus. \v 6 Alors, tous ensemble et d’une seule voix, vous rendrez gloire à Dieu, le Père de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}.

ko.L: 인내와 위로의 하나님께서 여러분에게 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수를 따라 서로 같은 생각을 품게 하시기를 바랍니다. \v 6 그리하여 여러분이 한마음으로 한 입으로 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 하나님 곧 아버지께 영광을 돌리게 되기를 바랍니다.
ko.B: 인내와 격려를 주시는 하나님께서 여러분이 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수의 뜻을 따라 서로 한마음이 되게 하시기를 빕니다. \v 6 그래서 여러분이 다 함께 한목소리로 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 하나님이시며 아버지이신 분께 영광을 돌리기를 바랍니다.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 우리에게 끝까지 견딜 힘을 주시고, 우리를 격려해 주십니다. 그 하나님께서 여러분이 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수를 따르면서 서로 마음을 같이하도록 도와주시기를 빕니다. \v 6 그러면 여러분 모두가 한목소리로 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 아버지이신 하나님께 영광을 돌리게 될 것입니다.

vi.L: Nguyện Đức Chúa Trời của sự kiên trì và của sự khích lệ ban cho anh chị em có cùng một tâm tình với nhau theo {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu, \v 6 để anh chị em đồng lòng, bằng một miệng tôn vinh Đức Chúa Trời và Cha của Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}.
vi.B: Nguyện Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng ban sự kiên trì và sự khích lệ, cho anh chị em được sống hòa hợp với nhau theo ý muốn của Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, \v 6 để anh chị em đồng lòng, cùng một tiếng nói tôn vinh Đức Chúa Trời, Cha của Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời ban cho chúng ta sức mạnh để bền bỉ, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khích lệ chúng ta. Cầu xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giúp anh chị em đồng lòng với nhau khi anh chị em đi theo Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}. \v 6 Rồi tất cả anh chị em sẽ cùng nhau, với một tiếng nói, tôn vinh Đức Chúa Trời, Cha của Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}.

pt.L: Ora, o Deus da perseverança e do encorajamento conceda a vocês pensar do mesmo [modo] uns com os outros, segundo {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} Jesus, \v 6 para que, de um só ânimo [e] com uma só boca, vocês glorifiquem o Deus e Pai do nosso Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}.
pt.B: Que o Deus que dá perseverança e encorajamento conceda a vocês viver em harmonia uns com os outros, como {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} Jesus quer, \v 6 para que juntos, a uma só voz, vocês deem glória ao Deus e Pai do nosso Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}.
pt.R: Deus nos dá força para continuar e nos anima. Que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} ajude vocês a viver em acordo uns com os outros, seguindo {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} Jesus. \v 6 Então todos vocês juntos, a uma só voz, vão glorificar a Deus, o Pai do nosso Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}.

am.L: የጽናትና የማበረታቻ አምላክ እንደ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ኢየሱስ [ፈቃድ] እርስ በርሳችሁ አንድ ዓይነት ሐሳብ እንድታስቡ ይስጣችሁ፤ \v 6 ይኸውም በአንድ ልብ በአንድ አፍ የጌታችን የኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} አምላክና አባት የሆነውን [እግዚአብሔርን] ታከብሩ ዘንድ ነው።
am.B: ጽናትንና ማበረታቻን የሚሰጥ እግዚአብሔር {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ኢየሱስ እንደሚፈልገው እርስ በርሳችሁ ተስማምታችሁ እንድትኖሩ ያድርጋችሁ፤ \v 6 ይኸውም በአንድነት በአንድ ድምፅ የጌታችን የኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} አምላክና አባት የሆነውን እግዚአብሔርን እንድታከብሩ ነው።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር እንድንጸና ብርታት ይሰጠናል፤ ያበረታታናልም። {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ኢየሱስን ስትከተሉ እርስ በርሳችሁ እንድትስማሙ ይርዳችሁ። \v 6 ያን ጊዜ ሁላችሁም በአንድነት በአንድ ድምፅ የጌታችን የኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} አባት የሆነውን እግዚአብሔርን ታከብራላችሁ።

decisions.choice: the God of endurance and encouragement: the God who gives them
decisions.reason: The two words repeat verse 4: what the Scriptures give, God gives through them. Paul names God in the same way in verse 13 ("the God of hope") and verse 33 ("the God of peace").

decisions.choice: to think the same among one another: to be of one mind, in harmony
alternatives: to hold the same opinions on every question
decisions.reason: φρονέω is about the outlook and attitude people share, as in 12:16 and Philippians 2:2. Chapter 14 has just allowed believers to differ about food and days; the unity asked for is one of mind and heart, not of every opinion.

decisions.choice: according to Christ Jesus: in the way Christ wills and shows
decisions.reason: κατά means "in keeping with". Christ is the pattern (verse 3, he did not please himself) and the standard for their life together.

decisions.choice: the God and Father of our Lord: one person, God who is Jesus' Father
alternatives: God, and the Father of our Lord
decisions.reason: One article covers both nouns: the God whom they praise is the Father of Jesus Christ. The same phrase is in 2 Corinthians 1:3 and Ephesians 1:3.

decisions.choice: God gives us strength to keep going, and he encourages us. May he help you ...
alternatives: May the God of endurance and encouragement give you ...
decisions.reason: Readable unpacks "the God of endurance and encouragement" into a short sentence of its own before the prayer.

decisions.choice: ustedes / vosotros forms
decisions.reason: As throughout the letter (see Romans 1:1), each plural "you" and its verb is a reader setting: ustedes (the default) or vosotros.

decisions.choice: le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus; Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}} (L), Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: French puts the article before "Christ Jésus" ("le Christ Jésus" / "le Messie Jésus"), outside the span, as in Colossians; after "Jésus" the title stands without the usual hyphen of "Jésus-Christ" so that both options read naturally.

decisions.choice: "같은 생각을 품다" (L); "한마음이 되다" (B); "마음을 같이하다" (R)
decisions.reason: To think the same among one another: to be of one mind, in harmony (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "하나님 곧 아버지" (L); "하나님이시며 아버지이신 분" (B); "아버지이신 하나님" (R); "영광을 돌리다" as settled at 1:21
decisions.reason: One person, God who is Jesus' Father (meaning decision); Korean "과" would suggest two.

decisions.choice: "Nguyện" (L, B); "Cầu xin" (R) for Paul's prayer-wishes (also 15:13, 15:33, 16:20, 16:24)
decisions.reason: The verb is a wish addressed to God (m1). "Nguyện" is the Vietnamese word for such a blessing, as in 1:7 and Colossians 4:18; Readable says "Cầu xin" (we pray that), as Romans 1:7 does at Readable.

decisions.choice: "Đức Chúa Trời và Cha của" (L); "Đức Chúa Trời, Cha của" (B, R)
decisions.reason: One person is meant, God who is Jesus' Father (m4). Literal keeps the Greek "and"; Balanced and Readable put the two titles side by side, which in Vietnamese plainly names one person.

decisions.choice: "የጽናትና የማበረታቻ አምላክ" (L); "የሰላም አምላክ" (15:33; 16:20)
decisions.reason: Amharic says 'the God of ...' with "አምላክ", the word the style guide keeps for God described by what belongs to him. Balanced and Readable often turn it into 'God, who gives ...' with "እግዚአብሔር", as the English does. In verse 6 'the God and Father of our Lord' becomes a description of God ("አምላክና አባት የሆነውን እግዚአብሔርን"), since Amharic needs one head noun; Literal brackets it.

source.text: Διὸ προσλαμβάνεσθε ἀλλήλους, καθὼς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς προσελάβετο ὑμᾶς, εἰς δόξαν τοῦ θεοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Therefore receive one another, just as also the Christ received you, for glory of the God.

en.L: Therefore receive one another, just as the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} also received you, for [the] glory of God.
en.B: So welcome one another, just as {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} has welcomed you, for the glory of God.
en.R: So accept each other and make each other welcome, just as {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} welcomed you. This brings glory to God.

es.L: Por tanto, {{plural_you:recíbanse|recibíos}} unos a otros, así como también {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} {{plural_you:los|os}} recibió, para [la] gloria de Dios.
es.B: Así que {{plural_you:acójanse|acogeos}} unos a otros, como {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} {{plural_you:los|os}} ha acogido, para gloria de Dios.
es.R: Así que {{plural_you:acéptense|aceptaos}} unos a otros y {{plural_you:recíbanse|recibíos}} con cariño, como {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} {{plural_you:los|os}} recibió. Esto da gloria a Dios.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo pokeaneni, kama vile {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} pia alivyowapokea ninyi, kwa ajili ya utukufu wa Mungu.
sw.B: Basi kila mmoja amkaribishe mwenzake, kama {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alivyowakaribisha ninyi, kwa utukufu wa Mungu.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo pokeaneni, na kila mmoja amkaribishe mwenzake kwa moyo mkunjufu, kama {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alivyowakaribisha. Jambo hilo humletea Mungu utukufu.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi accueillez-vous les uns les autres, comme le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} aussi vous a accueillis, pour [la] gloire de Dieu.
fr.B: Accueillez-vous donc les uns les autres, comme le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} vous a accueillis, pour la gloire de Dieu.
fr.R: Acceptez-vous donc les uns les autres et faites-vous bon accueil, comme le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} vous a accueillis. Cela rend gloire à Dieu.

ko.L: 그러므로 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서도 여러분을 받아들이신 것처럼, 하나님의 영광을 위하여 서로 받아들이십시오.
ko.B: 그러므로 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 여러분을 받아들이신 것처럼, 여러분도 서로 받아들여 하나님께 영광을 돌리십시오.
ko.R: 그러므로 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 여러분을 맞아들이신 것처럼, 서로 받아들이고 반갑게 맞아 주십시오. 그러면 하나님께서 영광을 받으십니다.

vi.L: Vì vậy, hãy tiếp nhận nhau, như {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} cũng đã tiếp nhận anh chị em, để Đức Chúa Trời được vinh quang.
vi.B: Vậy hãy tiếp nhận nhau, như {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} đã tiếp nhận anh chị em, để đem vinh quang về cho Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Vậy hãy chấp nhận và đón tiếp nhau, như {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} đã đón tiếp anh chị em. Điều này đem vinh quang về cho Đức Chúa Trời.

pt.L: Por isso, acolham uns aos outros, assim como também {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} acolheu vocês, para [a] glória de Deus.
pt.B: Por isso, acolham uns aos outros, assim como {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} acolheu vocês, para a glória de Deus.
pt.R: Por isso, aceitem e acolham uns aos outros, assim como {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} acolheu vocês. Isso dá glória a Deus.

am.L: ስለዚህ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሑ}} ደግሞ ለእግዚአብሔር ክብር እናንተን እንደ ተቀበለ እርስ በርሳችሁ ተቀባበሉ።
am.B: እንግዲህ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሑ}} እናንተን በደስታ እንደ ተቀበለ፣ እናንተም ለእግዚአብሔር ክብር እርስ በርሳችሁ ተቀባበሉ።
am.R: ስለዚህ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሑ}} እናንተን እንደ ተቀበለ፣ እናንተም አንዳችሁ ሌላውን ተቀበሉ፤ በደስታም ተቀባበሉ። ይህም ለእግዚአብሔር ክብር ያመጣል።

decisions.choice: receive: welcome into fellowship
decisions.reason: προσλαμβάνομαι is the verb of 14:1 and 14:3, "welcome the one who is weak in faith ... for God has welcomed him". It means taking someone in as one of your own, at your table and in your company.

decisions.choice: you
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT reads "you". Some manuscripts read "us", which would include Paul. The sense is the same: Christ's welcome is the pattern. Reviewers must check the apparatus.

decisions.choice: for the glory of God: the aim of Christ's welcome and of theirs
alternatives: only the aim of Christ's welcome
decisions.reason: The phrase stands after Christ's welcome but finishes the whole sentence: Christ welcomed them so that God would be glorified, and their welcome of one another has the same aim, as verses 6 and 9 say.

decisions.choice: accept each other and make each other welcome
decisions.reason: Readable uses two plain verbs to say what "receive" means here.

decisions.choice: accueillir, as in 14:1 and 14:3
decisions.reason: Paul uses the same verb as in 14:1 and 14:3 (welcome into fellowship, meaning decision), and French keeps one verb for all three so the link shows.

decisions.choice: "받아들이다" (L, B); "받아들이고 반갑게 맞아 주다" (R), as at 14:1
decisions.reason: Welcome into fellowship (meaning decision); the same verb as 14:1 and 14:3 ties the chapters together.

decisions.choice: "tiếp nhận" (L, B); "chấp nhận và đón tiếp" (R), the verb of 14:1
decisions.reason: The verb of 14:1 and 14:3, to welcome into fellowship (m1), keeps its word; Readable uses two verbs, as the English Readable does.

source.text: λέγω γὰρ Χριστὸν διάκονον γεγενῆσθαι περιτομῆς ὑπὲρ ἀληθείας θεοῦ, εἰς τὸ βεβαιῶσαι τὰς ἐπαγγελίας τῶν πατέρων, τὰ δὲ ἔθνη ὑπὲρ ἐλέους δοξάσαι τὸν θεόν· καθὼς γέγραπται· Διὰ τοῦτο ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι ἐν ἔθνεσι, καὶ τῷ ὀνόματί σου ψαλῶ.

records.literal_gloss: I say for Christ a servant to have become of circumcision for the sake of truth of God, for the to confirm the promises of the fathers, \v 9 the and Gentiles for the sake of mercy to glorify the God; just as it has been written: Because of this I will confess to you among Gentiles, and to the name of you I will sing.

en.L: For I say that {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} has become a servant of [the] circumcision for the sake of God's truth, in order to confirm the promises of the fathers, \v 9 and [that] the Gentiles [should] glorify God for [{{deity_pronoun:his|His}}] mercy; just as it is written: "Because of this I will praise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} among [the] Gentiles, and I will sing to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name."
en.B: For I tell you that {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} became a servant to the circumcised for the sake of God's truth, to make good the promises given to the patriarchs, \v 9 and so that the Gentiles might glorify God for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mercy. As it is written, "That is why I will praise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} among the Gentiles and sing praises to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name."
en.R: Here is what I mean. {{christos:Christ|The Messiah}} came to serve the Jewish people, to show that God tells the truth and keeps {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} word. He made sure that God's promises to their ancestors came true. \v 9 He also came so that people who are not Jews would give glory to God for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mercy. As Scripture says, "So I will praise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} among the nations. I will sing praises to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name."

es.L: Porque digo que {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} ha llegado a ser servidor de [la] circuncisión por causa de la verdad de Dios, para confirmar las promesas de los padres, \v 9 y [que] los gentiles [deben] glorificar a Dios por [{{deity_pronoun:su|Su}}] misericordia; así como está escrito: «Por esto {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} alabaré entre [los] gentiles, y cantaré salmos a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre».
es.B: Porque {{plural_you:les|os}} digo que {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} se hizo servidor de los circuncidados por causa de la verdad de Dios, para cumplir las promesas dadas a los patriarcas, \v 9 y para que los gentiles glorifiquen a Dios por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} misericordia. Como está escrito: «Por eso {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} alabaré entre los gentiles y cantaré alabanzas a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre».
es.R: Esto es lo que quiero decir. {{christos:Cristo|El Mesías}} vino a servir al pueblo judío, para mostrar que Dios dice la verdad y cumple {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} palabra. Se aseguró de que se cumplieran las promesas que Dios había hecho a sus antepasados. \v 9 También vino para que los que no son judíos den gloria a Dios por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} misericordia. Como dice la Escritura: «Por eso {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} alabaré entre las naciones. Cantaré alabanzas a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre».

sw.L: Kwa maana nasema kwamba {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} amekuwa mtumishi wa tohara kwa sababu ya kweli ya Mungu, ili kuthibitisha ahadi za mababa, \v 9 na [kwamba] watu wa mataifa wamtukuze Mungu kwa sababu ya rehema [{{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}]; kama ilivyoandikwa: "Kwa sababu hii nitakusifu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} kati ya watu wa mataifa, na nitaimba sifa kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}."
sw.B: Kwa maana nawaambia kwamba {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alifanyika mtumishi wa watu waliotahiriwa kwa sababu ya kweli ya Mungu, ili kutimiza ahadi walizopewa mababa wa kale, \v 9 na ili watu wa mataifa wamtukuze Mungu kwa sababu ya rehema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Kama ilivyoandikwa, "Ndiyo sababu nitakusifu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} kati ya watu wa mataifa, na kuimba sifa kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}."
sw.R: Hivi ndivyo ninavyomaanisha. {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alikuja kuwatumikia Wayahudi, ili kuonyesha kwamba Mungu husema kweli na hutimiza neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}. Alihakikisha kwamba ahadi za Mungu kwa mababu zao zinatimia. \v 9 Pia alikuja ili watu wasio Wayahudi wamtukuze Mungu kwa sababu ya rehema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Kama Maandiko yasemavyo, "Kwa hiyo nitakusifu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} kati ya mataifa. Nitaimba sifa kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}."

fr.L: Car je dis que {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} est devenu serviteur de [la] circoncision pour la vérité de Dieu, afin de confirmer les promesses des pères, \v 9 et [que] les nations [doivent] glorifier Dieu pour [{{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}}] miséricorde ; comme il est écrit : « C’est pourquoi je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louerai parmi [les] nations, et je chanterai pour {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom. »
fr.B: Car je vous le dis : le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} s’est fait serviteur des circoncis à cause de la vérité de Dieu, pour accomplir les promesses faites aux patriarches, \v 9 et pour que les nations glorifient Dieu pour {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} miséricorde. Comme il est écrit : « Voilà pourquoi je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louerai parmi les nations et je chanterai des louanges à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom. »
fr.R: Voici ce que je veux dire. Le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} est venu servir le peuple juif, pour montrer que Dieu dit la vérité et tient {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} parole. Il a fait en sorte que les promesses de Dieu à leurs ancêtres se réalisent. \v 9 Il est aussi venu pour que ceux qui ne sont pas juifs rendent gloire à Dieu pour {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} miséricorde. Comme le dit l’Écriture : « Alors je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louerai parmi les nations. Je chanterai des louanges à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom. »

ko.L: 내가 말합니다. {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서는 하나님의 진실하심을 위하여 할례받은 사람들의 종이 되셨습니다. 이는 조상들에게 주신 약속들을 확증하시고, \v 9 이방 사람들이 [그분의] 자비 때문에 하나님께 영광을 돌리게 하시려는 것입니다. 기록된 것과 같습니다. "그러므로 제가 이방 사람들 가운데서 주님을 찬양하고, 주님의 이름을 노래하겠습니다."
ko.B: 내 말은 이것입니다. {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서는 하나님의 진실하심을 보여 주시려고 할례받은 사람들을 섬기는 분이 되셨습니다. 그것은 조상들에게 주신 약속들을 확실하게 이루시고, \v 9 이방 사람들도 하나님의 자비 때문에 그분께 영광을 돌리게 하시려는 것이었습니다. 성경에 기록된 대로입니다. "그러므로 제가 이방 사람들 가운데서 주님을 찬양하고, 주님의 이름을 찬송하겠습니다."
ko.R: 내 말은 이런 뜻입니다. {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서는 유대 사람들을 섬기러 오셨습니다. 하나님께서 진실하시며 그분의 약속을 지키신다는 것을 보여 주시려는 것이었습니다. 그분은 하나님께서 그들의 조상들에게 하신 약속이 반드시 이루어지게 하셨습니다. \v 9 또 그분은 유대인이 아닌 사람들도 하나님의 자비 때문에 하나님께 영광을 돌리게 하시려고 오셨습니다. 성경에 이렇게 기록되어 있습니다. "그러므로 제가 모든 민족 가운데서 주님을 찬양하겠습니다. 주님의 이름을 노래하겠습니다."

vi.L: Vì tôi nói rằng {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} đã trở nên người phục vụ của những người cắt bì vì sự chân thật của Đức Chúa Trời, để xác nhận những lời hứa [ban cho] các tổ phụ, \v 9 và [để] các dân ngoại tôn vinh Đức Chúa Trời vì [lòng] thương xót [của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}]; như có chép: "Vì vậy tôi sẽ ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giữa các dân ngoại, và ca hát cho danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."
vi.B: Tôi nói rằng {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} đã trở nên người phục vụ cho những người chịu cắt bì vì sự chân thật của Đức Chúa Trời, để làm cho vững những lời hứa đã ban cho các tổ phụ, \v 9 và để các dân ngoại tôn vinh Đức Chúa Trời vì lòng thương xót của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Như có lời chép: "Vì thế tôi sẽ ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giữa các dân ngoại và hát ca tụng danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."
vi.R: Ý tôi là thế này. {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} đã đến để phục vụ dân Do Thái, để cho thấy Đức Chúa Trời nói thật và giữ lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Nhờ đó, những lời Đức Chúa Trời hứa với tổ tiên họ được thành sự thật. \v 9 {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} cũng đến để những người không phải Do Thái tôn vinh Đức Chúa Trời vì lòng thương xót của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Như Kinh Thánh chép: "Vì vậy tôi sẽ ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giữa các dân tộc. Tôi sẽ hát ca ngợi danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."

pt.L: Pois digo que {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} se tornou servo da circuncisão por causa da verdade de Deus, para confirmar as promessas dos pais, \v 9 e [que] as nações glorifiquem a Deus por [{{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}}] misericórdia; como está escrito: "Por isso eu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louvarei entre [as] nações, e cantarei ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome."
pt.B: Pois eu digo a vocês que {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} se tornou servo dos circuncidados por causa da verdade de Deus, para cumprir as promessas feitas aos patriarcas, \v 9 e para que os não judeus glorifiquem a Deus pela {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} misericórdia. Como está escrito: "Por isso eu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louvarei entre as nações e cantarei louvores ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome."
pt.R: É isto que quero dizer. {{christos:Cristo|O Messias}} veio servir o povo judeu, para mostrar que Deus fala a verdade e cumpre a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} palavra. Ele garantiu que as promessas de Deus aos antepassados deles se cumprissem. \v 9 Ele também veio para que os não judeus dessem glória a Deus pela {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} misericórdia. Como dizem as Escrituras: "Por isso eu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louvarei entre as nações. Cantarei louvores ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome."

am.L: {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ስለ እግዚአብሔር እውነት የመገረዝ አገልጋይ ሆኗል እላለሁና፤ ይኸውም ለአባቶች የተሰጡትን የተስፋ ቃሎች ያጸና ዘንድ ነው፤ \v 9 አሕዛብም ስለ ምሕረቱ እግዚአብሔርን ያከብሩ ዘንድ [ነው]፤ እንዲህ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ፦ «ስለዚህ በአሕዛብ መካከል አመሰግንሃለሁ፤ ለስምህም እዘምራለሁ።»
am.B: {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ስለ እግዚአብሔር እውነት ለተገረዙት አገልጋይ ሆነ እላችኋለሁ፤ ይህም ለቀደሙት አባቶች የተሰጡትን የተስፋ ቃሎች ለማጽናት ነው፤ \v 9 እንዲሁም አሕዛብ ስለ ምሕረቱ እግዚአብሔርን እንዲያከብሩ ነው። እንዲህ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ፦ «ስለዚህ በአሕዛብ መካከል አመሰግንሃለሁ፤ ለስምህም የምስጋና መዝሙር እዘምራለሁ።»
am.R: የምለው ይህ ነው። {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} የመጣው የአይሁድን ሕዝብ ለማገልገል ነው፤ ይህም እግዚአብሔር እውነተኛ እንደ ሆነና ቃሉን እንደሚጠብቅ ለማሳየት ነው። እርሱም እግዚአብሔር ለቀደሙት አባቶቻቸው የሰጠው የተስፋ ቃል እንዲፈጸም አደረገ። \v 9 ደግሞም አይሁድ ያልሆኑ ሕዝቦች ስለ ምሕረቱ እግዚአብሔርን እንዲያከብሩ መጣ። መጽሐፍ እንዲህ ይላል፦ «ስለዚህ በሕዝቦች መካከል አመሰግንሃለሁ፤ ለስምህ የምስጋና መዝሙር እዘምራለሁ።»

decisions.choice: the circumcision: the Jewish people
decisions.reason: περιτομή stands for the people who bear the sign of the covenant, as in 3:30 and 4:9. Jesus lived and served among Israel (Matthew 15:24).

decisions.choice: God's truth: God's faithfulness to his word
decisions.reason: ἀλήθεια here is God being true: he keeps what he has promised, as in 3:3-7. The next phrase explains it: Christ came to confirm the promises.

decisions.choice: the fathers: the patriarchs Abraham, Isaac and Jacob
decisions.reason: The promises were made to Abraham and his descendants (4:13, 9:4-5, 11:28), including the promise that the nations would be blessed through him (Genesis 12:3).

decisions.choice: and so that the Gentiles might glorify God: a second purpose of Christ's coming
alternatives: "I say ... that the Gentiles glorify God": a second thing Paul says
decisions.reason: The Greek joins "the Gentiles glorify" loosely to what goes before. It may be a second purpose alongside "to confirm", or a second statement after "I say". Either way, Christ's service brings both Israel's promises and the Gentiles' praise; the Gentiles praise God for mercy, Israel for his faithfulness.

decisions.choice: a quotation of Psalm 18:50 (also 2 Samuel 22:50)
decisions.reason: David, the anointed king, praises God among the nations after his victories. In the Hebrew he addresses God by the divine name; the words Paul quotes leave it out. Paul hears the words of the king fulfilled in the Messiah, David's descendant (1:3), so that God is praised among the Gentiles.

decisions.choice: people who are not Jews; in the quotation, the nations
decisions.reason: Readable says "people who are not Jews" in Paul's own words and "the nations" in the psalm, where it means the peoples of the world.

decisions.choice: the patriarchs
decisions.reason: "The fathers" could suggest the readers' own fathers; Balanced names the patriarchs, and Readable says "their ancestors".

decisions.choice: les nations (L, B, and the quotations at R); ceux qui ne sont pas juifs (R) (for chapters 15-16)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians: "les Gentils" is no longer current French and "les païens" now sounds pejorative; "les nations" keeps the biblical sense of the peoples other than Israel, and Readable says it plainly, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "할례받은 사람들의 종" (L); "할례받은 사람들을 섬기는 분" (B); "유대 사람들을 섬기다" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is a servant, not the letter's word for a slave; the circumcision is the Jewish people (meaning decision). Balanced uses the honorific "분" for Christ; Readable names the people.

decisions.choice: "이방 사람들" (L, B) / "유대인이 아닌 사람들" (R), as settled at 1:13; in the quotation "모든 민족" (R); the psalm in 합쇼체 to God with "주님" and "저", as at 15:3
decisions.reason: Readable follows the English Readable, which says "the nations" inside the quotation.

decisions.choice: "sự chân thật của Đức Chúa Trời" (L, B); "Đức Chúa Trời nói thật và giữ lời" (R)
decisions.reason: Here God's truth is his faithfulness to his word (m2). "Chân lý", the key term for truth, would be heard as a body of truth; "sự chân thật" is God being true to what he said.

decisions.choice: "người phục vụ" for Christ as servant
decisions.reason: The word is the one the Vietnamese Colossians renders "người phục vụ" (1:23, 4:7), kept apart from "đầy tớ" for doulos.

decisions.choice: "các tổ phụ" (L, B); "tổ tiên" (R)
decisions.reason: The fathers are the patriarchs (m3), "tổ phụ" as in 4:1 and 11:28; Readable says "tổ tiên" (ancestors).

decisions.choice: as nações, in the Old Testament quotations of verses 9-12
decisions.reason: In Paul's own words Balanced says "os não judeus" where the English says "Gentiles" (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 6). Inside the psalms, the Law and Isaiah, "Alegrem-se, não judeus" would put a modern phrase into the mouth of David and Moses; Portuguese Bibles say "as nações" there, which is also the word the Literal uses, so Balanced keeps "as nações" in the quotations.

decisions.choice: "አሕዛብ" (L, B); "አይሁድ ያልሆኑ ሕዝቦች" (R), and "ሕዝቦች" (peoples, nations) inside the Readable quotations
decisions.reason: "አሕዛብ" is the Bible's word for the Gentiles, but plain readers may not know it. Readable says who is meant; in the psalm and prophet quotations of verses 9-12 it says 'the peoples', as the English Readable says 'the nations'.

decisions.choice: "የመገረዝ አገልጋይ" (servant of circumcision, L); "ለተገረዙት" (to the circumcised, B); "የአይሁድን ሕዝብ" (R)
decisions.reason: 'The circumcision' stands for the Jewish people. Literal keeps the word, Balanced makes it the people who are circumcised, and Readable names them.

source.text: καὶ πάλιν λέγει· Εὐφράνθητε, ἔθνη, μετὰ τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ.

am.L: ደግሞም እንዲህ ይላል፦ «አሕዛብ ሆይ፣ ከሕዝቡ ጋር ደስ ይበላችሁ።»
am.B: ደግሞም እንዲህ ይላል፦ «እናንተ አሕዛብ፣ ከሕዝቡ ጋር ደስ ይበላችሁ።»
am.R: መጽሐፍ ደግሞ እንዲህ ይላል፦ «እናንተ የምድር ሕዝቦች፣ ከእርሱ ሕዝብ ጋር ደስ ይበላችሁ።»

decisions.choice: a quotation of Deuteronomy 32:43, from the Greek translation
decisions.reason: The words come from the end of the Song of Moses, in the Greek translation, which calls the nations to rejoice with God's people. The Hebrew text is shorter and differs here; Paul follows the Greek.

decisions.choice: it says: Scripture says
decisions.reason: No subject is named; it carries on from "it is written" in verse 9. Scripture speaking and God speaking amount to the same for Paul.

decisions.choice: his people: Israel
decisions.reason: In the Song of Moses God's people is Israel. The Gentiles are called to rejoice alongside Israel, not in its place, as in 11:17-18.

decisions.choice: you nations
decisions.reason: In the quotation Readable says "the nations", the peoples of the world, as in verse 9.

decisions.choice: the quotation in 해라체 ("기뻐하여라"), as settled at 2:24; "그분의 백성" (L); "주의 백성" (B, R)
decisions.reason: His people is Israel, God's people (meaning decision); Balanced and Readable name the Lord so the reader knows whose people.

decisions.choice: "[성경이]" (L)
decisions.reason: It says: Scripture says (meaning decision); Korean needs a subject for the verb.

decisions.choice: "Hỡi các dân ngoại" (L, B); "Hỡi các dân tộc" (R) in the quotations of 15:9-12
decisions.reason: Paul's own address to the readers is "thưa" (1:13), since "hỡi" belongs to older speech; but in a call from Scripture's songs "hỡi" is still the natural word of a hymn summoning the nations. Readable says "các dân tộc", as the English Readable says "you nations".

decisions.choice: o povo dele
decisions.reason: The nations are addressed with "vocês", so "o seu povo" would read as "your people"; "o povo dele" makes plain that the people is God's (m3).

source.text: καὶ πάλιν· Αἰνεῖτε, πάντα τὰ ἔθνη, τὸν κύριον, καὶ ἐπαινεσάτωσαν αὐτὸν πάντες οἱ λαοί.

decisions.choice: a quotation of Psalm 117:1
decisions.reason: The shortest psalm calls all nations to praise God for his steadfast love and faithfulness, the two things Paul has named in verses 8-9. In the Hebrew the divine name stands where the Greek has "Lord".

decisions.choice: all the peoples: every nation, not Israel alone
decisions.reason: The plural λαός is parallel to "all the Gentiles": the whole world is called to praise.

decisions.choice: you nations
decisions.reason: In the quotation Readable says "the nations", as in verses 9 and 10.

decisions.choice: makabila (peoples)
decisions.reason: The psalm pairs two words for the nations. "Mataifa" already renders the first, so the second is "makabila" (peoples, ethnic groups), which keeps the two lines distinct and says, as the meaning decision does, that every people is meant.

decisions.choice: "주" at every level inside the quotation, with no divine_name span, as at 9:28 and 11:34
decisions.reason: The Greek has the word for Lord; the Hebrew of Psalm 117:1 has the divine name, which the meaning decision on the quotation points to.

decisions.choice: "Chúa", not "CHÚA"
decisions.reason: The psalm has the divine name, but the Greek quotation has "Lord"; as in 9:28 and 10:13, the New Testament wording is followed with "Chúa".

am.L: ደግሞም ኢሳይያስ እንዲህ ይላል፦ «የእሴይ ሥር ይኖራል፤ አሕዛብንም ለመግዛት የሚነሣውም [ይኖራል]፤ አሕዛብ በእርሱ ተስፋ ያደርጋሉ።»
am.B: ደግሞም ኢሳይያስ እንዲህ ይላል፦ «የእሴይ ሥር ይመጣል፤ እርሱም አሕዛብን ለመግዛት የሚነሣ ነው፤ አሕዛብም ተስፋቸውን በእርሱ ላይ ያደርጋሉ።»
am.R: ኢሳይያስም እንዲህ ይላል፦ «ከእሴይ ዘር አንዱ ይመጣል። ሕዝቦችን ለመግዛት ይነሣል፤ ሕዝቦችም ተስፋቸውን በእርሱ ላይ ያደርጋሉ።»

decisions.choice: a quotation of Isaiah 11:10, from the Greek translation
decisions.reason: Isaiah foretells a king from the family of Jesse, King David's father (Isaiah 11:1). The Hebrew says the root of Jesse will stand as a signal to the peoples and the nations will seek him; the Greek translation, which Paul quotes, says he will rise to rule the nations and they will hope in him.

decisions.choice: the root of Jesse: a descendant of Jesse, the Messiah from David's line
decisions.reason: ῥίζα is a root, and so also the shoot that springs from it (Isaiah 11:1, 53:2; Revelation 5:5, 22:16). Paul opened the letter with Jesus as David's descendant (1:3).

decisions.choice: the one who rises: who comes forward to rule
alternatives: the one raised from the dead
decisions.reason: ἀνίστημι means to rise up or appear, here to take up rule. Paul may also hear in it Jesus' resurrection, since the same verb is used of rising from the dead, but the quotation itself speaks of a king's appearing.

decisions.choice: will hope: will put their hope in him
decisions.reason: The quotation ends on hope, the word that leads into the prayer of verse 13, "the God of hope".

decisions.choice: a descendant of Jesse
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what the picture of a root means.

decisions.choice: the nations
decisions.reason: In the quotation Readable says "the nations", as in verses 9-11.

decisions.choice: "Mzizi wa Yese atakuja" (personal agreement)
decisions.reason: "Mzizi" (root) is a class 3 noun, but here it names a person, the Messiah, so the verb takes personal agreement ("atakuja"), as "Neno" does in John. A reviewer may prefer the noun-class agreement.

decisions.choice: "이사야", "이새" in their Protestant forms; "이새의 뿌리" (L, B); "이새의 자손 가운데서 한 사람" (R)
decisions.reason: The root of Jesse is a descendant of Jesse, the Messiah from David's line (meaning decision); Readable says so, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "그에게" without the honorific inside the quotation, as at 9:33 and 10:11
decisions.reason: The prophet speaks of the coming ruler in the plain style of the quotation; the honorific outside quotations shows who he is.

decisions.choice: "rễ của Gie-sê" (L, B); "một người thuộc dòng dõi Gie-sê" (R)
decisions.reason: The root of Jesse is a descendant of Jesse, the Messiah of David's line (m2). Literal and Balanced keep Isaiah's picture; Readable says what it means. "Gie-sê" is the form of the Vietnamese Matthew (1:5-6).

decisions.choice: "đặt hy vọng nơi" at every level
decisions.reason: The verb is to put one's hope in him (m4). It keeps the word "hy vọng" settled for hope in 5:5, which returns in 15:13; "trông cậy" is the older church word.

source.text: ὁ δὲ θεὸς τῆς ἐλπίδος πληρώσαι ὑμᾶς πάσης χαρᾶς καὶ εἰρήνης ἐν τῷ πιστεύειν, εἰς τὸ περισσεύειν ὑμᾶς ἐν τῇ ἐλπίδι ἐν δυνάμει πνεύματος ἁγίου.

records.literal_gloss: The and God of the hope may fill you of all joy and peace in the believing, for the to abound you in the hope in power of Spirit Holy.

en.L: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, so that you abound in hope by [the] power of [the] Holy Spirit.
en.B: May the God of hope fill you with joy and peace of every kind as you believe, so that by the power of the Holy Spirit you overflow with hope.
en.R: God gives hope. May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} fill you completely with joy and peace as you believe. Then, by the power of the Holy Spirit, you will be full to overflowing with hope.

es.L: Ahora bien, que el Dios de la esperanza {{plural_you:los|os}} llene de todo gozo y paz al creer, para que {{plural_you:abunden|abundéis}} en la esperanza con [el] poder del Espíritu Santo.
es.B: Que el Dios de la esperanza {{plural_you:los|os}} llene de toda clase de gozo y de paz a medida que {{plural_you:creen|creéis}}, para que por el poder del Espíritu Santo {{plural_you:rebosen|reboséis}} de esperanza.
es.R: Dios da esperanza. Que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:los|os}} llene por completo de alegría y de paz mientras {{plural_you:creen|creéis}}. Así, por el poder del Espíritu Santo, {{plural_you:estarán|estaréis}} llenos de esperanza hasta rebosar.

sw.L: Na Mungu wa tumaini awajaze kila furaha na amani katika kuamini, ili mpate kufurika katika tumaini kwa uweza wa Roho Mtakatifu.
sw.B: Mungu wa tumaini awajaze furaha na amani ya kila namna mnapoamini, ili kwa uweza wa Roho Mtakatifu mjae tumaini hadi kufurika.
sw.R: Mungu hutoa tumaini. Na awajaze kabisa furaha na amani mnapoamini. Ndipo, kwa nguvu ya Roho Mtakatifu, mtajaa tumaini hadi kufurika.

fr.L: Que le Dieu de l’espérance vous remplisse de toute joie et de paix en croyant, pour que vous abondiez en espérance par [la] puissance de [l’]Esprit Saint.
fr.B: Que le Dieu de l’espérance vous remplisse de toute joie et de toute paix à mesure que vous croyez, afin que, par la puissance de l’Esprit Saint, vous débordiez d’espérance.
fr.R: Dieu donne l’espérance. Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous remplisse complètement de joie et de paix à mesure que vous croyez. Alors, par la puissance de l’Esprit Saint, vous serez remplis d’espérance au point d’en déborder.

ko.L: 소망의 하나님께서 믿음 안에서 모든 기쁨과 평안을 여러분에게 충만하게 하셔서, 여러분이 성령의 능력으로 소망이 넘치게 하시기를 바랍니다.
ko.B: 소망의 하나님께서 여러분이 믿을 때에 온갖 기쁨과 평안으로 여러분을 가득 채워 주셔서, 성령의 능력으로 여러분에게 소망이 넘치게 하시기를 빕니다.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 소망을 주시는 분입니다. 여러분이 믿을 때에 하나님께서 여러분을 기쁨과 평안으로 가득 채워 주시기를 빕니다. 그러면 성령의 능력으로 여러분에게 소망이 넘쳐흐를 것입니다.

vi.L: Nguyện Đức Chúa Trời của niềm hy vọng làm cho anh chị em đầy dẫy mọi niềm vui và bình an trong khi tin, để anh chị em được dư dật trong niềm hy vọng bởi quyền năng của Đức Thánh Linh.
vi.B: Nguyện Đức Chúa Trời của niềm hy vọng cho anh chị em tràn đầy mọi niềm vui và bình an khi anh chị em tin, để nhờ quyền năng của Đức Thánh Linh, anh chị em được tràn trề niềm hy vọng.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời là Đấng ban niềm hy vọng. Cầu xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho anh chị em được tràn đầy niềm vui và bình an khi anh chị em tin. Rồi bởi quyền năng của Đức Thánh Linh, anh chị em sẽ có niềm hy vọng dồi dào, tràn ngập.

pt.L: Ora, o Deus da esperança encha vocês de toda alegria e paz no crer, para que vocês transbordem na esperança, pelo poder do Espírito Santo.
pt.B: Que o Deus da esperança encha vocês de toda alegria e paz, à medida que vocês creem, para que, pelo poder do Espírito Santo, vocês transbordem de esperança.
pt.R: Deus dá esperança. Que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} encha vocês completamente de alegria e paz, enquanto vocês acreditam. Então, pelo poder do Espírito Santo, vocês vão ficar tão cheios de esperança que ela vai transbordar.

am.L: የተስፋ አምላክ በማመን ሁሉን ደስታና ሰላም ይሙላችሁ፤ ይኸውም በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ኃይል በተስፋ እንድትትረፈረፉ ነው።
am.B: የተስፋ አምላክ ስታምኑ ሁሉን ዓይነት ደስታና ሰላም ይሙላችሁ፤ ይኸውም በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ኃይል ተስፋችሁ ሞልቶ እንዲትረፈረፍ ነው።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ተስፋን ይሰጣል። ስታምኑ በደስታና በሰላም ፈጽሞ ይሙላችሁ። ከዚያም በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ኃይል ተስፋችሁ ሞልቶ ይፈስሳል።

decisions.choice: the God of hope: the God who gives hope and in whom hope rests
decisions.reason: The phrase takes up the last word of verse 12 ("the Gentiles will hope") and the hope of verse 4. As in verse 5, "of" names what God gives.

decisions.choice: in believing: joy and peace come as they go on believing
decisions.reason: The present infinitive describes ongoing trust. Joy and peace are not added to faith from outside; they fill those who keep trusting God.

decisions.choice: so that: the purpose and outcome of the prayer
decisions.reason: The construction with περισσεύω ("to abound, overflow") gives the aim: hope more than enough, which only the Spirit's power can produce (5:5, 8:23-25).

decisions.choice: God gives hope. May he fill you ...
alternatives: May the God of hope fill you ...
decisions.reason: Readable puts the meaning of "the God of hope" in a sentence of its own before the prayer.

decisions.choice: "평안" at every level for the peace God gives, as at 1:7; "믿음 안에서" (L) / "믿을 때에" (B, R) for "in believing"
decisions.reason: Joy and peace come as they go on believing (meaning decision); this is peace in the heart, not peace between people (14:17, 14:19).

decisions.choice: "믿음 안에서" (L) for the verb "believing"
decisions.reason: Korean has no verbal noun as short as the Greek; a reviewer may prefer "믿는 가운데", which keeps the verb.

source.text: Πέπεισμαι δέ, ἀδελφοί μου, καὶ αὐτὸς ἐγὼ περὶ ὑμῶν, ὅτι καὶ αὐτοὶ μεστοί ἐστε ἀγαθωσύνης, πεπληρωμένοι πάσης γνώσεως, δυνάμενοι καὶ ἀλλήλους νουθετεῖν.

records.literal_gloss: I am persuaded and, brothers of me, also myself I concerning you, that also yourselves full you are of goodness, filled with all knowledge, being able also one another to admonish.

en.L: Now I myself am also convinced about you, my {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, that you yourselves are also full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.
en.B: My {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, I myself am convinced about you: you are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, and able to counsel one another.
en.R: My {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, I am sure that you are full of goodness. You know a great deal, and you are able to correct and teach one another.

es.L: Ahora bien, yo mismo también estoy convencido acerca de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, hermanos míos, de que {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} mismos también {{plural_you:están|estáis}} llenos de bondad, colmados de todo conocimiento, capaces también de amonestar{{plural_you:se|os}} unos a otros.
es.B: Hermanos míos, yo mismo estoy convencido de que {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:están|estáis}} llenos de bondad, colmados de todo conocimiento y capaces de aconsejar{{plural_you:se|os}} unos a otros.
es.R: Hermanos míos, estoy seguro de que {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:están|estáis}} llenos de bondad. {{plural_you:Saben|Sabéis}} mucho, y {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} corregir{{plural_you:se|os}} y enseñar{{plural_you:se|os}} unos a otros.

sw.L: Basi mimi mwenyewe pia nina hakika kuwahusu ninyi, ndugu zangu, kwamba ninyi wenyewe pia mmejawa na wema, mkiwa mmejaa ujuzi wote, mkiweza pia kuonyana.
sw.B: Ndugu zangu, mimi mwenyewe nina hakika juu yenu: mmejawa na wema, mna ujuzi wote, na mnaweza kushauriana.
sw.R: Ndugu zangu, nina uhakika kwamba mmejaa wema. Mnajua mambo mengi, na mnaweza kurekebishana na kufundishana.

fr.L: Or je suis moi-même aussi persuadé à votre sujet, mes {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, que vous-mêmes aussi vous êtes pleins de bonté, remplis de toute connaissance, capables aussi de vous avertir les uns les autres.
fr.B: Mes {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, j’en suis moi-même convaincu à votre sujet : vous êtes pleins de bonté, remplis de toute connaissance, et capables de vous conseiller les uns les autres.
fr.R: Mes {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, je suis sûr que vous êtes pleins de bonté. Vous savez beaucoup de choses, et vous êtes capables de vous reprendre et de vous enseigner les uns les autres.

ko.L: 나의 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 나 자신도 여러분에 대하여 확신합니다. 여러분 자신이 선함으로 가득하고, 모든 지식으로 채워져 있어서, 서로 권면할 수도 있다는 것입니다.
ko.B: 나의 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 나는 여러분에 대해 확신합니다. 여러분은 선함이 가득하고 모든 지식으로 채워져 있어서, 서로 바르게 일깨워 줄 수 있습니다.
ko.R: 나의 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 나는 여러분이 선한 마음으로 가득하다는 것을 확신합니다. 여러분은 많은 것을 알고 있고, 서로 바로잡아 주고 가르쳐 줄 수 있습니다.

vi.L: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} của tôi, chính tôi cũng tin chắc về anh chị em rằng chính anh chị em cũng đầy lòng tốt, được đầy dẫy mọi tri thức, và cũng có khả năng khuyên bảo lẫn nhau.
vi.B: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} của tôi, chính tôi tin chắc về anh chị em: anh chị em đầy lòng tốt, đầy đủ mọi tri thức, và có thể khuyên bảo nhau.
vi.R: Thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}} của tôi, tôi tin chắc rằng anh chị em đầy lòng tốt. Anh chị em hiểu biết nhiều, và có thể sửa dạy lẫn nhau.

pt.L: Ora, eu mesmo também estou convencido a respeito de vocês, meus {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, de que vocês mesmos também estão cheios de bondade, repletos de todo conhecimento, capazes também de admoestar uns aos outros.
pt.B: Meus {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, eu mesmo estou convencido a respeito de vocês: vocês estão cheios de bondade, repletos de todo conhecimento e capazes de aconselhar uns aos outros.
pt.R: Meus {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, tenho certeza de que vocês são cheios de bondade. Vocês sabem muita coisa e são capazes de corrigir e ensinar uns aos outros.

am.L: {{gender:ወንድሞቼና እኅቶቼ|ወንድሞቼ}} ሆይ፣ እናንተ ራሳችሁ ደግሞ በበጎነት የተሞላችሁ፣ በእውቀት ሁሉ የተሞላችሁ፣ እርስ በርሳችሁም ደግሞ ልትገሣሠጹ የምትችሉ እንደ ሆናችሁ እኔ ራሴ ደግሞ ስለ እናንተ ተረድቻለሁ።
am.B: {{gender:ወንድሞቼና እኅቶቼ|ወንድሞቼ}} ሆይ፣ እኔ ራሴ ስለ እናንተ እርግጠኛ ነኝ፤ በበጎነት የተሞላችሁ፣ በእውቀትም ሁሉ የተሞላችሁ፣ እርስ በርሳችሁም ልትመካከሩ የምትችሉ ናችሁ።
am.R: {{gender:ወንድሞቼና እኅቶቼ|ወንድሞቼ}} ሆይ፣ በበጎነት የተሞላችሁ እንደ ሆናችሁ እርግጠኛ ነኝ። ብዙ ነገር ታውቃላችሁ፤ እርስ በርሳችሁም ልትተራረሙና ልትማማሩ ትችላላችሁ።

decisions.choice: I myself ... you yourselves: emphatic
decisions.reason: Both pronouns are stressed. Paul himself, who has never met them, is confident of them; they themselves, without his help, are able to teach one another. His bold words (verse 15) are not a sign of distrust.

decisions.choice: knowledge: understanding of God's truth and will
decisions.reason: γνῶσις here is knowledge of the gospel and of how to live by it, enough to guide one another.

decisions.choice: admonish: warn and set right by teaching
decisions.reason: νουθετέω is to put sense into someone's mind: to warn, counsel or correct, as a parent or a friend would (1 Thessalonians 5:14, Colossians 3:16).

decisions.choice: counsel (B); correct and teach (R)
decisions.reason: "Admonish" is rare in everyday English; Balanced says "counsel", and Readable names the two sides of it.

decisions.choice: hermanos, no setting
decisions.reason: As in Romans 1:13, "hermanos" already includes the sisters, so Spanish has no gender span here.

decisions.choice: ndugu, no setting
alternatives: ndugu wa kiume na wa kike
decisions.reason: As in Romans 1:13, "ndugu" already means brothers and sisters, so Swahili has no gender span here.

decisions.choice: "권면하다" (L); "바르게 일깨워 주다" (B); "바로잡아 주고 가르쳐 주다" (R)
decisions.reason: To warn and set right by teaching (meaning decision); "훈계하다" sounds like a superior scolding.

decisions.choice: "tri thức" (L, B); "khuyên bảo" (L, B), "sửa dạy" (R)
decisions.reason: Knowledge is understanding of God's truth (m2); "tri thức" is the word kept for this Greek noun (2:20, 11:33), with "sự hiểu biết" for the other word for knowledge. To admonish is to warn and set right by teaching (m3): "khuyên bảo" is counsel with correction; "răn bảo" sounds stern.

decisions.choice: the address "Thưa anh chị em của tôi" first (L)
decisions.reason: As in 7:1, Vietnamese puts the address at the head of the sentence.

decisions.choice: {{gender:ወንድሞቼና እኅቶቼ|ወንድሞቼ}} ሆይ, first in the address
alternatives: the address in the middle of the sentence, as in the Greek
decisions.reason: Paul addresses the whole church, men and women; the gender setting chooses between the two Amharic forms of address. Amharic puts a vocative with "ሆይ" at the start of the sentence, since the verb must end it.

source.text: τολμηρότερον δὲ ἔγραψα ὑμῖν ἀπὸ μέρους, ὡς ἐπαναμιμνῄσκων ὑμᾶς, διὰ τὴν χάριν τὴν δοθεῖσάν μοι ὑπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ εἰς τὸ εἶναί με λειτουργὸν Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ εἰς τὰ ἔθνη, ἱερουργοῦντα τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ θεοῦ, ἵνα γένηται ἡ προσφορὰ τῶν ἐθνῶν εὐπρόσδεκτος, ἡγιασμένη ἐν πνεύματι ἁγίῳ.

records.literal_gloss: More boldly and I wrote to you in part, as reminding you, because of the grace the given to me by the God \v 16 for the to be me a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as priest the gospel of the God, so that may become the offering of the Gentiles acceptable, sanctified in Spirit Holy.

en.L: But I have written to you rather boldly in part, as reminding you, because of the grace given to me by God \v 16 so that I might be a minister of {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus to the Gentiles, serving the gospel of God as a priest, so that the offering of the Gentiles might become acceptable, sanctified by [the] Holy Spirit.
en.B: Yet on some points I have written to you quite boldly, to remind you of them again. I have done so because of the grace God gave me \v 16 to be a minister of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus for the Gentiles. I serve the gospel of God like a priest, so that the Gentiles may become an offering that God accepts, made holy by the Holy Spirit.
en.R: But in some parts of this letter I have written to you very boldly, to remind you of things you already know. I did this because of the grace God has given me. \v 16 By that grace I serve {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus among people who are not Jews. My work is like a priest's work: I tell them God's good news. Then they can be an offering that God is glad to accept, made holy by the Holy Spirit.

es.L: Pero {{plural_you:les|os}} he escrito con bastante audacia en parte, como recordándo{{plural_you:les|os}}, por causa de la gracia que me fue dada por Dios \v 16 para que yo sea ministro {{christos:de Cristo Jesús|del Mesías Jesús}} para los gentiles, sirviendo como sacerdote al evangelio de Dios, a fin de que la ofrenda de los gentiles llegue a ser aceptable, santificada por [el] Espíritu Santo.
es.B: Sin embargo, en algunos puntos {{plural_you:les|os}} he escrito con bastante atrevimiento, para recordar{{plural_you:les|os}} esas cosas otra vez. Lo he hecho por la gracia que Dios me dio \v 16 para ser ministro {{christos:de Cristo Jesús|del Mesías Jesús}} para los gentiles. Sirvo al evangelio de Dios como un sacerdote, para que los gentiles lleguen a ser una ofrenda que Dios acepta, santificada por el Espíritu Santo.
es.R: Pero en algunas partes de esta carta {{plural_you:les|os}} he escrito con mucho atrevimiento, para recordar{{plural_you:les|os}} cosas que ya {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}}. Lo hice por la gracia que Dios me ha dado. \v 16 Por esa gracia sirvo {{christos:a Cristo Jesús|al Mesías Jesús}} entre los que no son judíos. Mi trabajo es como el de un sacerdote: les anuncio la buena noticia de Dios. Así ellos pueden llegar a ser una ofrenda que Dios recibe con agrado, hecha santa por el Espíritu Santo.

sw.L: Lakini katika sehemu fulani nimewaandikia kwa uthubutu zaidi, nikiwakumbusha, kwa sababu ya neema iliyotolewa kwangu na Mungu \v 16 ili niwe mhudumu wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu kwa watu wa mataifa, nikiifanyia Injili ya Mungu huduma ya kikuhani, ili sadaka ya watu wa mataifa iwe yenye kukubalika, iliyotakaswa katika Roho Mtakatifu.
sw.B: Hata hivyo, kuhusu mambo fulani nimewaandikia kwa ujasiri mwingi, ili kuwakumbusha tena. Nimefanya hivyo kwa sababu ya neema ambayo Mungu alinipa \v 16 niwe mhudumu wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu kwa ajili ya watu wa mataifa. Ninaitumikia Injili ya Mungu kama kuhani, ili watu wa mataifa wawe sadaka ambayo Mungu anaikubali, iliyotakaswa na Roho Mtakatifu.
sw.R: Lakini katika sehemu kadhaa za barua hii nimewaandikia kwa ujasiri mkubwa, ili kuwakumbusha mambo mnayoyajua tayari. Nimefanya hivyo kwa sababu ya neema ambayo Mungu amenipa. \v 16 Kwa neema hiyo ninamtumikia {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu kati ya watu wasio Wayahudi. Kazi yangu ni kama kazi ya kuhani: ninawahubiria watu hao Habari Njema ya Mungu. Ndipo wanaweza kuwa sadaka ambayo Mungu anafurahi kuipokea, iliyofanywa takatifu na Roho Mtakatifu.

fr.L: Mais je vous ai écrit assez hardiment, en partie, comme pour vous rappeler [ces choses], à cause de la grâce qui m’a été donnée par Dieu \v 16 pour que je sois ministre du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus auprès des nations, accomplissant comme un prêtre le service de l’Évangile de Dieu, afin que l’offrande des nations soit agréée, sanctifiée par [l’]Esprit Saint.
fr.B: Pourtant, sur certains points, je vous ai écrit avec une certaine audace, pour vous les rappeler. Je l’ai fait à cause de la grâce que Dieu m’a donnée \v 16 d’être ministre du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus pour les nations. Je sers l’Évangile de Dieu comme un prêtre, afin que les nations deviennent une offrande que Dieu accepte, sanctifiée par l’Esprit Saint.
fr.R: Mais dans certaines parties de cette lettre, je vous ai écrit avec beaucoup d’audace, pour vous rappeler des choses que vous savez déjà. Je l’ai fait à cause de la grâce que Dieu m’a donnée. \v 16 Par cette grâce, je sers le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus parmi ceux qui ne sont pas juifs. Mon travail ressemble à celui d’un prêtre : je leur annonce la bonne nouvelle de Dieu. Alors ils peuvent devenir une offrande que Dieu est heureux d’accepter, rendue sainte par l’Esprit Saint.

ko.L: 그러나 나는 여러분에게 다시 생각나게 하려고 부분적으로 더 담대하게 썼습니다. 하나님께서 내게 주신 은혜 때문입니다. \v 16 이 은혜는 내가 이방 사람들을 위한 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수의 일꾼이 되어, 하나님의 복음을 위하여 제사장으로 섬기게 하신 것입니다. 이는 이방 사람들이라는 제물이 성령으로 거룩하게 되어 [하나님께서] 기쁘게 받으실 만한 것이 되게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 그러나 나는 몇 가지 점에서 여러분에게 다시 기억나게 하려고 꽤 담대하게 썼습니다. 하나님께서 나에게 주신 은혜 때문에 그렇게 한 것입니다. \v 16 그 은혜로 나는 이방 사람들을 위한 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수의 일꾼이 되었습니다. 나는 제사장처럼 하나님의 복음을 섬깁니다. 그래서 이방 사람들이 성령으로 거룩하게 되어, 하나님께서 기쁘게 받으시는 제물이 되게 하려는 것입니다.
